description: Delete every WhatsApp menu definition and all menu routing from amplify/functions/messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py, and replace each former menu send with one plain-text catch-all so no customer hits silence or a crash. Removes the live one-menu config, the retired main menu, the customer-service submenu, the Bharat Stack submenu, the language/region picker, every menu getter, the MENU_TO_KEYWORD dispatch table and its branches, and _send_interactive_list itself (confirmed to have no non-menu caller). Keeps the trigger keyword SETS (HI_KEYWORDS, BUTTON_MENU_TRIGGERS, CUSTOMERSERVICE_KEYWORDS) and only changes what they do, because the task requires typing menu/hi/get started to reach the catch-all rather than crash - you cannot route a trigger word without a trigger-word set. Also replaces tests/test_one_menu.py, which exists solely to assert the deleted menus. Independent of FEAT-002 (different file, no shared symbol).
steps: Re-derive line numbers first: run `.venv/bin/python .scratch/menu_extents.py` (it already exists and prints the current line range of every function and menu dict named below). A concurrent session committed ed1f3911 to this file during planning, so offsets may have moved again. Then run `git status --short` as its OWN command and confirm no uncommitted modification to this handler; if there is one, it belongs to another session - stop and report rather than editing over it.

Record the test baseline: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_one_menu.py tests/test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py tests/test_inbound_whatsapp.py tests/test_content.py tests/test_wa_internal_event.py -q` and note the pass count.
Add module constant MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT = "We're refreshing our menu - please type *menu* and we'll help you." immediately after DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MESSAGE (line 133). Use this exact copy, verbatim.

Add helper _send_menu_placeholder(contact_id, phone_number_id, request_id) immediately ABOVE _send_interactive_list (currently line 5004), so it sits where the thing it replaces used to be. It logs one line {'event': 'menu_placeholder_sent', 'contactId': mask_contact_id(contact_id), 'requestId': request_id} then calls _send_ai_auto_reply(contact_id, MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT, phone_number_id, request_id) - the module's existing plain-text sender at 4694-4731. Keep it to about six lines so it is trivial to swap for a real menu later.

Repoint the six reachable menu send sites in _process_message at the helper. In each, replace ONLY the _send_interactive_list(... list_config=_get_welcome_config() ...) call with _send_menu_placeholder(contact_id, aws_phone_number_id, request_id); keep every surrounding logger.info, return, try/except and DynamoDB welcomeSent update byte for byte. Sites in file order: 1436-1443 followup_explore button tap; 1623-1637 request_welcome; 1667-1685 BUTTON_MENU_TRIGGERS; 1928-1952 HI_KEYWORDS; 1984-1998 CUSTOMERSERVICE_KEYWORDS; 2064-2090 brand-new-contact welcome (the welcomeSent write MUST stay, or the placeholder re-sends on every message from a new contact).

Do NOT alter the keyword sets at 1667-1669 (BUTTON_MENU_TRIGGERS), 1928-1930 (HI_KEYWORDS) or 1984 (CUSTOMERSERVICE_KEYWORDS), and do NOT alter the literal guard expressions at 1670-1672, 1931 and 1985. tests/test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py asserts four of those guard strings character for character (see its test_menu_sets_use_the_fallback). Update only the surrounding comments that still claim a menu is sent.

Gut _handle_list_reply (6642-6914) down to: the existing list_reply_received log line (keep listId in full - a row id is not a secret and is the only correlation handle) plus a single _send_menu_placeholder(contact_id, phone_number_id, request_id). Keep the function name and its five-parameter signature exactly; it is called with keyword arguments at 1455-1461 and sender_phone becomes unused but must remain. This one edit deletes the MENU_TO_KEYWORD dict (6665-6750, about 60 ids), `action = MENU_TO_KEYWORD.get(list_id)` (6752), the _customerservice_menu / _bharat_stack_menu / _main_menu / _language_menu branches (6757-6792), every _cta_* branch (_cta_faq, _cta_gift_card, _cta_store, _cta_bharat_stack, _cta_about, _cta_help), the keyword-triggered-flow dispatch loop over _get_flow_triggers_config(), the `pay` branch that invokes wecare-invoice-engine, and the list_reply_unhandled tail. Also remove the stale MENU_TO_KEYWORD mentions in comments at 6279 and 6962.

Accept and record the deliberate consequence: a tap on a row still sitting in a customer's chat history no longer reaches a flow or a payment - it gets the placeholder. That is exactly what 'delete the dispatch logic that routes list_reply ids to actions' means. Every typed-keyword equivalent (pay, store, gift card, faq, about, help & about, and all DEFAULT_FLOW_TRIGGERS keywords) is untouched, so nothing becomes unreachable by every route.

Delete every menu definition and getter, each together with its leading comment banner (the banners describe menus that no longer exist): DEFAULT_ONE_MENU 6956-6969 plus banner 6944-6955; DEFAULT_MAIN_MENU 6976-7007 plus banner 6970-6975; DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_PICKER 7009-7025; REGION_LANGUAGE_LISTS 7028-7086; _get_welcome_config 7089-7117; DEFAULT_BHARAT_STACK_MENU 7121-7139 plus banner; _get_bharat_stack_menu 7142-7155; DEFAULT_CUSTOMERSERVICE_MENU 7162-7223 plus banner; _get_customerservice_menu 7226-7239; _get_language_picker_config 7242-7265; _get_region_language_list 7268-7284.

Delete _send_interactive_list (5004-5050). Re-confirm with `grep -n '_send_interactive_list' <file>` that the only remaining references are the ones you are about to remove; it has no non-menu caller (verified during planning across all 12 call sites).

Keep _get_welcome_config_key (125-130) and _load_welcome_text (320-333) - they read the welcome_message / welcome_message_2 TEXT config, not a menu. Keep DEFAULT_FLOW_TRIGGERS (6280-6446) and _get_flow_triggers_config - they drive typed keyword flows. Keep _send_cta_button, _send_followup_buttons (5152-5166) and _send_help_about (5169-5197) - they still have callers from the typed-keyword paths STORE_KEYWORDS, GIFT_KEYWORDS, FAQ_KEYWORDS, ABOUT_KEYWORDS, BHARAT_KEYWORDS and HELP_ABOUT_KEYWORDS, none of which this task touches.

Delete the unreachable tail of _process_ai_automation (7399-7836). First confirm by AST that `return None` is the first non-docstring statement in its body (planning measured body = ['Expr', 'Return', 'Assign']); if it is not, STOP and report instead of guessing. Then delete every statement after that return, keeping the def, the full signature, the docstring and `return None`. This is what removes the last _send_interactive_list call sites (7525, 7542, 7550, 7558, 7613, 7622) and the showMainMenu / showSubMenu / showLanguagePicker dispatch, and it is required because that dead code references the getters deleted above.

Delete tests/test_one_menu.py. Every class in it asserts a menu that no longer exists (DEFAULT_ONE_MENU shape, DEFAULT_MAIN_MENU / DEFAULT_CUSTOMERSERVICE_MENU / DEFAULT_BHARAT_STACK_MENU row resolution, MENU_TO_KEYWORD contents, _get_welcome_config, the retired submenu branches). Carry its one still-valuable class forward: TestTheRivalMenuIsGone, which reads amplify/functions/ai/ai-generate-response/handler.py and asserts DEFAULT_BOT_FLOW defines no mainMenu or subMenus.

Create tests/test_menus_are_deleted.py. Reuse the module-loading fixture from tests/test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py verbatim in shape (unique module name via importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, with sys.path inserts for amplify/functions/shared, the handler dir and its modules dir) - a plain `import handler` is unsafe because conftest.py clears sys.modules['handler'] and every Lambda entry point in the repo shares that filename. Assert: (a) the inbound handler module has no attribute named DEFAULT_ONE_MENU, DEFAULT_MAIN_MENU, DEFAULT_CUSTOMERSERVICE_MENU, DEFAULT_BHARAT_STACK_MENU, DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_PICKER, REGION_LANGUAGE_LISTS, _get_welcome_config, _get_customerservice_menu, _get_bharat_stack_menu, _get_language_picker_config, _get_region_language_list or _send_interactive_list; (b) an ast.walk of the source finds no ast.Assign target named MENU_TO_KEYWORD at any nesting depth, and no Call to _send_interactive_list anywhere; (c) _handle_list_reply exists, still takes five parameters, and its source segment contains _send_menu_placeholder; (d) MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT equals the agreed string exactly; (e) for each of HI_KEYWORDS, BUTTON_MENU_TRIGGERS and CUSTOMERSERVICE_KEYWORDS, the source between its assignment and the following `return` contains _send_menu_placeholder and does not contain _send_interactive_list; (f) ai-generate-response's DEFAULT_BOT_FLOW still defines no mainMenu or subMenus.

Run tests/test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py WITHOUT editing it first. It should be green, because every assertion is about keyword-set membership, _STANDBY_TEXT_TRIGGERS, _DETERMINISTIC_KEYWORDS, strip_decorative_edges and the literal guard expressions - none of which this feature removes. If test_menu_sets_use_the_fallback fails, a guard string was altered: that is the bug, fix the handler, not the test. Then update only its module docstring and the class/method names that say 'open the menu' to say 'reach the placeholder'.

Confirm the handler still imports: load it by file path under a unique module name with boto3.resource and boto3.client patched, and confirm no exception. Do NOT deploy, do NOT run scripts/deploy_all_lambdas.py or scripts/snapstart_publish.py, do NOT move any live alias, do NOT delete any Lambda.

Record in this FEAT's findings field: the final `grep -c` results proving the wipe, the before/after pass counts, anything marked 'verify during implementation' in plan.md that you resolved, and whether DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MESSAGE (line 133, still says "Type 'menu' to see available options") was left alone.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -nE "HI_KEYWORDS|BUTTON_MENU_TRIGGERS|CUSTOMERSERVICE_KEYWORDS|_send_menu_placeholder|MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT" amplify/functions/messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py` finds all five, and each of the three trigger paths calls _send_menu_placeholder
An AST check shows _process_ai_automation has exactly two body statements: the docstring Expr and `return None`
The inbound handler loads by file path with boto3 patched and raises nothing
tests/test_one_menu.py no longer exists and no longer appears in pytest collection
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_menus_are_deleted.py tests/test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py tests/test_inbound_whatsapp.py tests/test_content.py tests/test_wa_internal_event.py -q` passes
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q` passes, with the only delta against the recorded baseline being test_one_menu.py's tests removed and test_menus_are_deleted.py's added
No deploy command was run and no live alias moved
verification: cd /Users/wecaredigital/wecare-store && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_menus_are_deleted.py tests/test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py tests/test_inbound_whatsapp.py tests/test_content.py tests/test_wa_internal_event.py -q
findings:
DONE. inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py: 8388 -> 7301 lines (1087 removed).

GREP PROOF (acceptance criterion 1): `grep -cE "DEFAULT_ONE_MENU|DEFAULT_MAIN_MENU|DEFAULT_CUSTOMERSERVICE_MENU|DEFAULT_BHARAT_STACK_MENU|DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_PICKER|REGION_LANGUAGE_LISTS|MENU_TO_KEYWORD|_get_welcome_config\(|_get_customerservice_menu|_get_bharat_stack_menu|_get_language_picker_config|_get_region_language_list|_send_interactive_list"` = 0, grep exit 1. Two comment-only mentions survived the first pass and were reworded: the _send_menu_placeholder docstring (said 'where _send_interactive_list used to') and the DEFAULT_FLOW_TRIGGERS banner (then handler.py:6279, said keywords must include 'the list_reply action keyword from MENU_TO_KEYWORD' - now says the row ids no longer dispatch). A plain symbol deletion does NOT satisfy the criterion; the comments must go too.

KEPT (criterion 2): MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT at line 139, _send_menu_placeholder def at 4980, and 8 `_send_menu_placeholder(` occurrences = 1 def + 7 calls. Seven, not six: the six _process_message sites (followup_explore 1443, request_welcome 1633, BUTTON_MENU_TRIGGERS 1670, HI_KEYWORDS 1933, CUSTOMERSERVICE_KEYWORDS 1977, brand-new-contact 2053) plus _handle_list_reply 6600. All three trigger SETS intact at 1664 / 1920 / 1969 with their guard expressions byte-identical - test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py::test_menu_sets_use_the_fallback passed WITHOUT editing it (33 passed), which is the evidence that no guard string moved.

AST INVARIANT (criterion 3): _process_ai_automation body is exactly ['Expr','Return'] (docstring + `return None`), 10 args preserved, now lines 6744-6749 (was 7399-7836). The pre-delete check found ['Expr','Return','Assign'] as planning predicted, so no STOP was triggered. _handle_list_reply keeps all five params ['list_id','contact_id','phone_number_id','sender_phone','request_id']; sender_phone is now unused and that is deliberate (callers pass by keyword at 1455-1461).

IMPORT (criterion 4): loads by file path under a unique module name with boto3.resource and boto3.client patched, raises nothing; MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT reads back verbatim and all four spot-checked menu attributes are absent.

TESTS. Baseline before: focused 5 files = 150 passed; full `tests/ -q` = 9 failed, 6785 passed, 1 skipped, 7 xfailed. After: focused 5 files (test_one_menu swapped for test_menus_are_deleted) = 153 passed; full = 9 failed, 6788 passed, 1 skipped, 7 xfailed. Delta is exactly +3 = test_one_menu.py's 24 tests removed, test_menus_are_deleted.py's 27 added. The 9 failures are IDENTICAL before and after and belong to other sessions' work - test_blog_ledger, test_checkout_website_handler, test_coupons_iam_and_table (3), test_email_verification_handler, test_gift_cards_iam_and_table (2), test_provision_checkout_contract. None is in this feature's blast radius; do not attribute them to the menu wipe.

tests/test_one_menu.py deleted via `git rm` and confirmed absent from pytest collection (0 matches in --collect-only). Its one still-valuable class, TestTheRivalMenuIsGone, is carried into tests/test_menus_are_deleted.py; its companion test_ai_handler_returns_to_the_one_menu was NOT carried, because it asserted that ai-generate-response's menuResponses point at show_main_menu 'which the inbound handler resolves to the one menu' - there is no one menu to resolve to any more, so the assertion had lost its subject. The no-mainMenu/no-subMenus assertion (criterion f) is kept.

PLAN ITEMS MARKED 'verify during implementation' THAT I RESOLVED. plan.md note 6 asked whether a dashboard config row overrides DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MESSAGE before touching the default. Answer: NO. _load_fallback_message reads SystemConfigTable id='wa_auto_response' and takes config['fallbackMessage']; a filtered Scan of stack-wecare-digital-SystemConfigTable for that id returns Count=0, so no row exists and the module default is what ships. DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MESSAGE (line 133) was therefore LEFT ALONE, unchanged, still "Thanks for your message! Type 'menu' to see available options, or 'subscribe' to get started." That is now accurate rather than stale: typing 'menu' hits HI_KEYWORDS and reaches the placeholder. If a later step wants to reword it, there is no config row to reconcile against. (plan.md's other 'verify during implementation' note, at line 367, concerns whatsapp-calling and tests/test_calling.py - that is FEAT-002's file and I did not touch it.)

ONE MORE COMMENT CORRECTED beyond the step list: the _DECORATIVE_RANGES banner (line ~276) justified applying strip_decorative_edges to the greeting sets because 'a false positive shows a menu'. Reworded to 'costs a stray reply'. The scope argument it protects (never apply the fallback to PAY_KEYWORDS or MY_ID_KEYWORDS) is unchanged and still pinned by test_money_and_record_creating_sets_do_not_use_the_fallback.

ACCEPTED CONSEQUENCE, for the final report. A tap on a list row still sitting in a customer's chat history no longer reaches a flow or a payment - it gets the placeholder. MENU_TO_KEYWORD's ~60 ids are gone, so menu_pay no longer invokes wecare-invoice-engine and no row reaches _get_flow_triggers_config. Every typed-keyword equivalent is untouched and still works: pay, store, gift card, faq, about, help & about, BHARAT_KEYWORDS, and all DEFAULT_FLOW_TRIGGERS keywords. _send_cta_button, _send_followup_buttons and _send_help_about survive with their typed-keyword callers intact (verified present at 4994 / 5093 / 5110).

NOT LIVE. No deploy of any kind was run: no scripts/deploy_all_lambdas.py, no scripts/snapstart_publish.py, no aws lambda update-function-code, no alias move, no Lambda deletion. wecare-inbound-whatsapp-handler sits behind a `live` alias, so this is $LATEST only - the menus REMAIN LIVE on both WABAs until the owner authorises a publish and alias move. Separately, the wd_menu template was deleted at Meta by the owner, so any send still referencing it fails now regardless.

FILES: amplify/functions/messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py (edited), tests/test_menus_are_deleted.py (new, 27 tests), tests/test_one_menu.py (deleted), tests/test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py (docstring + one class rename TestOwnPrefillsReachTheMenu -> TestOwnPrefillsReachThePlaceholder; no assertion changed). whatsapp-calling/handler.py untouched - FEAT-002 owns it. Scratch helper .scratch/wipe_menus.py is gitignored and not committed.
